blocks.text: A slower rhythm — one image at a time.

01-river-view-down-valley.jpg.title: River View Down Valley, Cathedral Rock on Left
01-river-view-down-valley.jpg.alt: Still water reflects tall pines while pale Yosemite cliffs recede into haze.
01-river-view-down-valley.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. River View Down Valley, Cathedral Rock on Left, 1861. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

02-yosemite-falls-river-view.jpg.title: Yosemite Falls, River View, 2637 Feet
02-yosemite-falls-river-view.jpg.alt: A broad granite ridge rises beyond a riverbank crowded with dark conifers.
02-yosemite-falls-river-view.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Yosemite Falls, River View, 2637 Feet, 1861. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

03-el-capitan-4000-feet.jpg.title: Tutucanula, El Capitan, 4000 Feet
03-el-capitan-4000-feet.jpg.alt: El Capitan towers above a quiet river and a low band of pine trees.
03-el-capitan-4000-feet.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Tutucanula, El Capitan, 4000 Feet, 1861. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

04-domes-sentinel-dome.jpg.title: The Domes from Sentinel Dome
04-domes-sentinel-dome.jpg.alt: A sunlit granite dome rises beyond forested slopes viewed from a high ridge.
04-domes-sentinel-dome.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. The Domes from Sentinel Dome, 1866. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

05-cascade-nevada-fall.jpg.title: Cascade, Nevada Fall on Left, View above Vernal Fall
05-cascade-nevada-fall.jpg.alt: White water runs through smooth granite shelves beneath a dense stand of pines.
05-cascade-nevada-fall.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Cascade, Nevada Fall on Left, View above Vernal Fall, 1861. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

06-nevada-fall.jpg.title: Nevada Fall, 700 Feet
06-nevada-fall.jpg.alt: A waterfall drops between dark trees into a rock-lined pool crossed by fallen trunks.
06-nevada-fall.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Nevada Fall, 700 Feet, 1861. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

07-lower-yosemite-falls.jpg.title: Lower Yosemite Falls
07-lower-yosemite-falls.jpg.alt: A bright vertical waterfall cuts through a shadowed wall of rock and trees.
07-lower-yosemite-falls.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Lower Yosemite Falls, 1860s. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

08-cathedral-rock.jpg.title: Cathedral Rock
08-cathedral-rock.jpg.alt: The sheer face of Cathedral Rock fills the frame above a line of conifers.
08-cathedral-rock.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Cathedral Rock, 1861. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

09-view-columbia-cascades.jpg.title: View on the Columbia, Cascades
09-view-columbia-cascades.jpg.alt: The Columbia River bends past wooded banks toward faint mountains on the horizon.
09-view-columbia-cascades.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. View on the Columbia, Cascades, 1867. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

10-cape-horn-celilo.jpg.title: Cape Horn near Celilo
10-cape-horn-celilo.jpg.alt: A massive column of rock rises beside a river and a straight rail line.
10-cape-horn-celilo.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Cape Horn near Celilo, 1867. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

11-mount-shasta-north.jpg.title: Mount Shasta from the North
11-mount-shasta-north.jpg.alt: Snow-covered Mount Shasta rises above a dark open plain and distant tree line.
11-mount-shasta-north.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Mount Shasta from the North, 1870. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

12-devils-canyon.jpg.title: Devil's Canyon, Geysers, Looking Down
12-devils-canyon.jpg.alt: A rugged canyon descends between brushy slopes, cut by pale mineral channels.
12-devils-canyon.jpg.description: Carleton E. Watkins. Devil's Canyon, Geysers, Looking Down, 1868–70. The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
